description: This Kotlin source file defines the `ScanFragment` class, a user interface component in an Android application responsible for listing nearby and bonded Bluetooth devices, managing Bluetooth discovery, requesting required permissions, and storing selected devices for later use.

classes.name: ScanFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that manages Bluetooth device discovery, display, and selection. It handles Bluetooth permissions, scans for devices, displays bonded and discovered devices in a list, and allows the user to select and store a device for connection.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment UI layout containing RecyclerView and control buttons.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the UI components, sets up the RecyclerView adapter, and loads bonded devices.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers broadcast receivers for Bluetooth discovery events.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters broadcast receivers and cancels ongoing Bluetooth discovery.

methods.name: isConnectPermissionGranted
methods.description: Checks if BLUETOOTH_CONNECT permission is granted.

methods.name: isScanPermissionGranted
methods.description: Checks if BLUETOOTH_SCAN permission is granted.

methods.name: listBondedDevices
methods.description: Retrieves and displays bonded Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: startDiscovery
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth device discovery after permission checks and updates UI state.

methods.name: saveSelectedDevice
methods.description: Saves the selected Bluetooth device's name and address into shared preferences.

methods.name: getDeviceDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly display name for a Bluetooth device, considering permissions.

search-terms: which permissions are needed for Bluetooth
